notes: PR left OPEN; one English comment; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5Unified.
Primary evidence is virtual-device validation of the pin-table effect and of the guard's effect (A/B by removing the guard locally), plus the cross-repo pin-table comparison.
The no-guard image is a local test variant, not part of the PR.

Non-blocking observation: a sketch calling M5.Ex_I2C.begin() directly on a port-less board still opens the soft port on the stale pins (ret=1 observed); pre-existing behaviour, worth a separate decision.
